service.en: Register a student in a charter school
service.ur: چارٹر اسکول میں طالب علم کا اندراج

about: Let a parent apply to enrol a child in a charter school.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Proof of residence such as house ownership, notarised lease, electricity bill or an Abu Dhabi Police or Armed Forces lease
Comprehensive evaluation report and analysis report, if available
channels: TAMM website or app, through the available channels
